fact: The Identity Secu application was officially deployed on Friday 8 May 2026 at the Gendarmerie nationale's PK9 brigade in Libreville, which was equipped with computer hardware for it; citizens file a complaint online from a phone and follow their case file, the service at first covering some fifteen districts of the capital with extension to other zones planned in the following months.
title: Sécurité et Digitalisation : Identity Secu débarque à la Brigade du Pk9, la Gendarmerie gabonaise accélère sa modernisation
